name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion project depends on its complexity, the scope of work, and the efficiency of the permitting process. On average, a garage conversion can take anywhere from 3 to 6 months from initial design to final inspection. This includes time for architectural plans, permit acquisition (which can vary widely), construction, and finishing touches. A detailed project schedule will be provided once the scope is defined.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion typically takes 3 to 6 months from design to completion, including permitting and construction phases.
